# openmetadata_notification_template (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata notification template. Templates hold the Jinja subject and body rendered when an alert or event subscription fires.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_notification_template" "asset_created" {
  name         = "asset-created-email"
  display_name = "Asset created (email)"
  description  = "Subject and body used by the data platform team when an asset is created."

  template_subject = "New asset: {{ entity.name }}"

  template_body = <<-EOT
    Hello {{ user.displayName }},

    A new {{ entity.entityType }} named {{ entity.name }} was created.
    Open it here: {{ entity.href }}
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Template name. Changing it replaces the template, because the name is also its fully qualified name.
- `template_body` (String) Jinja template for the notification body.
- `template_subject` (String) Jinja template for the notification subject.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the template.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name. For a notification template this equals name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `is_modified_from_default` (Boolean) Whether the template differs from the OpenMetadata built-in default.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_notification_template.asset_created 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, which for a notification template is its name.
terraform import openmetadata_notification_template.asset_created asset-created-email
```
